customManagers.description: The virtual printer's simulavr commit (vt350#224): pedrolamas/simulavr's master head. SIMULAVR_TREE_SHA256 must change with it; .github/workflows/repin-virtualprinter.yml (renovate-fixup) recomputes it on the renovate/* branch.

packageRules.description: The virtual printer's and kalisim's build pins (vt350#224) in one monthly PR: the builder image digest, simulavr's commit, simulavr's build python package. renovate-fixup (.github/workflows/repin-virtualprinter.yml) then recomputes what Renovate can't (simulavr's tree sha256, pip_lock.py's hashes) and updates cad/tools.md, which lists every pin.

Moonraker's python packages are a pip freeze of Moonraker's own requirement ranges, and its direct dependencies already sit at the top of those ranges: a Renovate bump past them fails the image's pip check. The monthly repin workflow re-resolves the whole list within the ranges instead (cad/repin-virtualprinter.sh moonraker).

The Kalico runtime image is pinned by digest only and must hold the same commit as KALICO_SHA (test_kalico_batch.py checks klippy/.version), so it moves by hand with KALICO_SHA; the monthly health review reports the drift.
